title: Established i18n — maintenance planning for small UI enhancement
description: Synthetic app with sound next-intl-style Spanish catalog. Agent must plan a small enhancement using existing conventions and stop for approval before edits.

criteria.description: Maintenance workflow reference is loaded (tool trace shows reading references/maintenance.md).
During planning phase, fixture files are not modified.
Plan reuses the established message engine and catalog conventions; does not propose unjustified library replacement.
Plan introduces new message keys (catalog entries) rather than hard-coded user-visible JSX strings for the enhancement.
Plan stays scoped to the requested enhancement; does not expand into a repository-wide audit or migration.
Agent requests explicit approval before editing files.
